tasks.description: Propose a concise set of mutually distinct options for the project goal. Give every option a short lowercase identifier and a description.

Using the candidate-set dependency, return a JSON object with one key named questions. Its value must be a TypeSafe question map containing: a Choice named best_option whose criteria exactly match the candidate identifiers; a Noul named acceptable_risk; and a Score named overall_fit with 3 to 5 ordered levels. Use only type, instructions, and criteria fields. Return this JSON text in result and an empty notes array.
Evaluate the generated candidates using the generated, runtime-validated question pack.

state.goal: Choose the option with the strongest quality, practicality, reversibility, and cost balance.
